newsitem.title: USA: Tabloid reporter nabbed for chasing Victoria Kennedy.
newsitem.headline: Tabloid reporter nabbed for chasing Victoria Kennedy.

text.p: A reporter was facing charges of assault and battery on Tuesday for trying to get a little too close to a member of the Kennedy family.

Martin Gould, a reporter for the weekly tabloid The Star, allegedly followed Victoria Kennedy, who recently separated from her husband Michael, as she drove with another family member from the couple's home town of Cohasset to Hingham, Massachusetts along the state's south shore.
She told police Gould had tried to run her off the road. When she reached Hingham, she pulled over to the local police station where she flagged down an officer.
"Mrs. Kennedy then pointed to the vehicle and said that's the car right there," Hingham Police Lt. Joseph McCracken told reporters. Hingham police issued Gould a traffic citation.
It was unclear if the charges were already filed against the reporter. Cohasset police declined all comment.
Meanwhile, police and prosecutors continued investigating whether Michael Kennedy had sexual relations with a 14-year-old girl who was the family's babysitter.
